machine: Iron Maiden: Legacy of the Beast (Stern Pinball, 2018)

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Runs up the left side, feeds the mid-right flipper; a spinner sits on the lane. 2nd-most-important shot.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Wire ramp returning to the left inlane; Mummy lock and Tomb collect on Premium/LE.

shots.name: Center Ramp (Pharaoh / Jump Ramp)
shots.notes: The single most important shot; starts Eddie Battles, multiballs, and is the safe bailout.

shots.name: Mummy Captive Ball (Sarcophagus)

shots.name: Right Ramp

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Runs up the right side, feeds the upper-left mini flipper; Tomb collect on Pro (right loop area).

shots.name: 3-Bank Drop Targets

shots.name: Super Jackpot Target

shots.name: Orange X Targets (Playfield X)

shots.name: Extra Ball 'X' Target

Spell EDDIE via the white arrows, then start a mode at the center ramp

Keep alternating lit shots while the timer runs

goals.title: Extra Ball Target
goals.summary: Push game progress until the Extra Ball X target lights, then take a clean shot at it before the ball ends.
goals.reward: Extra ball

steps.detail: Mystery awards can also hand you the extra ball

steps.action: Shoot the lit Extra Ball X target to collect it
steps.detail: Collect it as soon as it lights; do not carry it into a risky multiball

goals.title: Attract-Mode Game Mode Menu
goals.summary: Iron Maiden keeps a menu behind its attract screen that most players walk right past. It switches the whole ruleset between the standard game, a Competition variant with the randomised elements stripped out for fair head-to-head play, and a jukebox.
instructions: Hold both flipper buttons while the machine sits in attract mode with no game in progress
Keep holding until the menu appears on the display
Choose Standard, Competition, or DJ Mixer, then start your game
Competition is the full ruleset with random elements removed
DJ Mixer is a jukebox and does not affect scoring
goals.reward: Switches the ruleset to Competition, with random elements removed, or DJ Mixer, instead of Standard

goals.title: Collect Four Eddie Cards at Two Levels
goals.summary: Four cards stand between you and the Beast, and every one of them comes in a weak version and a strong version. The weak version drops for the headline achievement in its feature. The strong version wants that same feature multiplied or repeated. The difference only shows itself when the fight goes badly: a level 1 card disappears the moment you fail against the Beast, while a level 2 card stays exactly where it is. Bank all four at level 2 and a loss costs you nothing but time, because you can line up another attempt straight away. Cards also fatten the Power Jackpot while you hold them.
instructions: Trooper card: level 1 arrives with a Trooper Multiball super jackpot. Level 2 wants a 5x jackpot, or every jackpot advanced to 3x.
Mummy card: level 1 arrives with a Mummy Multiball super jackpot. Level 2 wants a second super jackpot in the same game.
Cyborg card: level 1 arrives with Cyborg Multiball, which finishing all five power features lights. Level 2 wants a 5x super jackpot inside that multiball.
Soldier card: level 1 drops for starting 2 Minutes to Midnight. Level 2 wants a 2x super jackpot during it.
All four cards qualify Number of the Beast at either level, so there is no penalty for taking the fight early with weak cards.
Lose the fight and every level 1 card you were holding is gone. Level 2 cards stay, and a full set of four lets you go back in without rebuilding anything.
goals.reward: Qualifies Number of the Beast; level 2 cards survive a failed attempt and raise the Power Jackpot

goals.title: Finish All Five Power Features
goals.summary: The playfield sorts its shots into five families - ramps, orbits, spinners, standup targets and bumpers - and each family tracks your hits on its own. Feed one family enough and that power feature switches on. Keep feeding the same family and it completes. Your first completion lights the Power Jackpot at the Orb, and this is where patience pays: finish another feature while that jackpot is still sitting there and it does not simply grow, it picks up a multiplier. Cash in too early and you take a fraction of what the same shot would have paid two features later. Clear all five and Cyborg Multiball opens up.
instructions: Pound one family of shots - ramps, orbits, spinners, targets or bumpers - until that power feature switches on.
Stay on the same family to finish the feature off rather than spreading hits across all five at once.
Your first completed feature lights the Power Jackpot at the Orb target.
Every extra feature you complete while that jackpot is still lit adds a multiplier instead of just more points, so leave it lit longer than feels comfortable.
Eddie cards you are holding and the +5x Tomb Treasure push the same jackpot up, so line those up before you collect.
Complete all five features to light Cyborg Multiball at the bullseye on the centre jump ramp.
goals.reward: A multiplying Power Jackpot at the Orb, plus Cyborg Multiball once all five features are finished

goals.title: Bank a Soul Shard From Every Battle
goals.summary: Winning a battle is only half the job. The instant it ends the bullseye at the centre jump ramp lights for a short hurry-up, and that is your one chance to claim that battle's Soul Shard. Drain or dither and it is gone. Hit the bullseye squarely rather than clipping it and the multiplier on the award climbs. Shards are the currency of the late game: each fresh one lights a Tomb Treasure, they feed the jackpots in 2 Minutes to Midnight, and beating the Beast pays every shard you hold all over again. There are five, one for each battle.
instructions: Shoot the white arrow shots to spell EDDIE, which lights a battle at the Pharaoh centre ramp.
While the mode start is still unlit, the left spinner rotates which of the five battles is queued, so pick your battle before you finish spelling EDDIE.
Shoot the centre ramp to start the battle and see it through - the shard only lights when you finish a battle successfully.
The bullseye at the centre jump ramp lights immediately afterwards for a short hurry-up. Go straight for it, and hit it clean, because accuracy multiplies the award.
Each new shard lights a Tomb Treasure, adds to what 2 Minutes to Midnight pays, and gets re-scored if you beat the Beast.
goals.reward: One Soul Shard per battle; each lights a Tomb Treasure and pays again later in the game

goals.title: Climb the Ten Tomb Treasures
goals.summary: The Tomb is a fixed ladder, not a random award, so you always know exactly what the next prize is worth before you shoot for it. Seven kinds of achievement light a treasure and each one only counts the first time you manage it, so repeating your favourite trick buys nothing. Count the five Soul Shards separately and there is one more way to light a treasure than there are treasures to hand out. The tenth is the whole reason to climb: it opens Run to the Hills.
instructions: Light a treasure the first time you collect each Soul Shard, score a loop jackpot, make a 6-way combo, land a Mummy super jackpot, land a Trooper super jackpot, beat the Beast, or hold all four Eddie cards at level 2.
Collect them at the right loop on a Pro, or at the left ramp on a Premium or LE.

Know the ladder before you shoot it: 15 million, super slingshots, Can I Play With Madness, super combos, extra ball lit, revive lit, 2x bonus, +5x Power Jackpot, then 50 million with a free level 2 Eddie card.
The tenth treasure starts Run to the Hills, the machine's final wizard mode.
goals.reward: Ten fixed awards in a known order, ending with Run to the Hills

achievements.title: Beast Put Down

achievements.title: Six-Shot Chain

achievements.title: Loop Ladder

drills.title: Hold Left, Plunge Hard
drills.text: Hold the left flipper and plunge hard so the ball takes the inner orbit and rolls onto the upper-left mini flipper, then shoot the Super Jackpot target from there. The free Playfield X it hands you is worth more than the points, so have the inlane plan ready before you plunge.

drills.title: Mini Loop Reps
drills.text: Work the Mini Loop off the upper-left mini flipper over and over. It is the hardest shot on the machine and it is what multiplies the whole loop farm, so build it before you go hunting Loop Jackpots.

drills.title: Catch The Orbit Feed
drills.text: Shoot the left orbit and catch the return dead on the mid-right flipper instead of letting it roll off. Everything that flipper reaches, the centre ramp, the captive ball and the Big Loop, is a different shot from a cradle than from a moving ball.

drills.title: Shatz The Gravestone
drills.text: From a right-flipper cradle, shatz the ball across through the left inlane into the Gravestone target. It spots an X target outside modes, which means one technique shot buys you real progress toward Playfield X.

drills.title: Revive Before Anything Else
drills.text: Rip the REVIVE spinner on the first ball until the word is spelled. The outlanes are what end balls on this machine, the right one especially off the Big Loop exit, and a completed Revive carries between balls.

drills.title: Six-Way, No Rush
drills.text: Chain all six majors in any order you like: left ramp, Big Loop, left orbit, Mini Loop, right ramp, right orbit, then cash it into the centre of the Bullseye. There is no combo timer, so a missed link is a decision you made and not a clock that beat you.

actionButton.how: Iron Maiden's lockdown bar is bare — there is nothing to press. Everything here comes off the four flippers and a manual shooter rod: soft plunge into the skill-shot target, or hold the left flipper on the plunge for the Super Skill Shot. No award in the game is collected with a button.

howItPlays.objective: Fight through Eddie's world by winning the five Eddie Battles for their Soul Shards and starting the four multiballs for their Eddie Cards. Hold all four cards to face the Beast, and climb the ten Tomb Treasures to reach the Run to the Hills finale.
loop: Spell EDDIE on the white-arrow shots to light a battle at the center Pharaoh ramp, and rip the left-orbit spinner beforehand to pick which of the five battles is queued.
Start the queued battle at the center ramp and win it, then take the Bullseye hurry-up right after to bank that battle's Soul Shard and light a Tomb Treasure.
Complete the drops to arm Trooper, spell MUMMY at the captive ball, and finish the Power Features to start the multiballs, each of which awards an Eddie Card.
Hold all four Eddie Cards to fight the Beast at the Bullseye; keep lighting Tomb Treasures until the tenth opens Run to the Hills.

lights.name: Eddie Battles
lights.lit: The center Pharaoh ramp lights once EDDIE is spelled, meaning a battle is queued and ready to start, and it stays lit until you shoot the ramp to begin it.
lights.then: Before EDDIE finishes, rip the left-orbit spinner to change the queued battle until it lands on one you can shoot cleanly. Win it to light the Bullseye for a short Soul Shard hurry-up, and see all five battles through to qualify the Soldier card mode.

lights.name: REVIVE Spinner
lights.lit: Each lit letter of R-E-V-I-V-E is one you have already banked on the left spinner, and the finished word stays lit from ball to ball rather than resetting.
lights.then: Rip the REVIVE spinner early to spell it out, because the wide outlanes are what end balls here - especially the right one off the Big Loop exit. A completed Revive kicks a lost outlane ball back into play, and it doubles in value while Fear of the Dark runs.

lights.name: Playfield X Inlanes
lights.lit: A lit return inlane means Playfield X is qualified and waiting to switch on; you qualify it first by completing the scattered orange X targets, and again for 3X, before either inlane lights.
lights.flashing: The active multiplier insert flashes faster as its roughly twenty-second run nears the end.

control.effect: a tap of either flipper button moves the lit return inlane from one side to the other, so you can slide it under whichever inlane the ball is dropping into and start the multiplier on your own terms
control.when: before the ball reaches the return lanes

lights.then: Line the lit inlane up with a flipper, roll through it, and 2X or 3X runs on everything for about twenty seconds - time it just before a Super Jackpot or a big combo cash instead of bleeding the clock. A right-flipper shatz through the left inlane into the Gravestone spots an extra X target outside modes.

lights.name: Trooper Drop Targets
lights.lit: The award lit above the drop bank is whatever the drops will pay next time you clear them, cycling between Advance Bonus X, Mystery and Light Locks.
lights.then: Knock the whole bank down in a single shot to grab the lit award plus a second one at doubled drop value. Clear it while Light Locks shows to arm Trooper Multiball, or while Advance Bonus X shows to climb your end-of-ball multiplier toward its cap.

lights.name: Mummy Captive Ball
lights.lit: Hitting the Sarcophagus captive ball lights the letters of M-U-M-M-Y, and once the word is spelled the Mummy lock lights at the center ramp.
lights.then: Spell MUMMY, lock a ball at the lit center-ramp lock, then spell MUMMY again to start Mummy Multiball and earn the Mummy Eddie Card. During the multiball, re-spelling it lights the Super Jackpot at the Bullseye.

lights.name: Power Features
lights.lit: Every kind of shot on the machine belongs to a Power Feature family - ramps, orbits, spinners, targets, bumpers - and each family lights on its own once you have fed it enough hits.
lights.then: Pound one family at a time to finish its feature; the first one you complete opens a Power Jackpot at the Orb, and any feature you finish while it still sits there stacks a multiplier onto it rather than just points. Finish every family to start Cyborg Multiball at the Bullseye.

lights.name: Eddie Cards to the Beast
lights.lit: Each Eddie Card lights as you earn it - Trooper from a Trooper super, Mummy from a Mummy super, Cyborg from finishing the Power Features, Soldier from starting 2 Minutes to Midnight - and a card banked at level two survives a failed Beast fight.
lights.then: Collect all four cards to qualify Number of the Beast at the Bullseye, then shoot a red-arrow shot and the Bullseye to parry and land fifteen counter-attacks. Winning pays a hundred million plus the value of every Soul Shard you banked along the way.

lights.name: Tomb Treasure Ladder
lights.lit: The Tomb is a fixed ten-rung ladder collected at the right loop, so you always know what the next award is worth, and each of the seven qualifying feats only lights a treasure the first time you manage it.
lights.then: Bank each new Soul Shard, loop jackpot, six-way combo, Mummy or Trooper super, Beast win, or a full hand of level-two cards to light the next treasure, then collect it at the loop. The tenth Tomb Treasure starts Run to the Hills, the six-ball final wizard mode.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper button to move the lit return inlane from one side to the other, so you can catch the ball on whichever side it returns. You must qualify Playfield X first at the orange X targets - once qualified, rolling the lit inlane starts about twenty seconds of 2X (or 3X) scoring on everything.

scoring.text: Take the Super Skill Shot with a held-flipper plunge for a free Playfield X and pour it straight into points. Spell REVIVE early for outlane insurance, then spell EDDIE and start an easy battle at the center ramp, keeping that ramp as your safe bailout.

Start a single-ball battle before Trooper Multiball so the two stack, then collect multiplied Super Jackpots under a live Playfield X. Farm the Big Loop and Mini Loop for Loop Jackpots, and climb Bonus X on the drops in the background.

Hold all four Eddie Cards to fight the Beast at the Bullseye - landing every counter-attack pays a hundred million plus every Soul Shard you banked. Climb all ten Tomb Treasures to start Run to the Hills, the six-ball final wizard, and note that a single clean six-way combo cashed into a Super Deathblow can spike near nine hundred million on its own.
